encode_xyz_to_z_order_key: encode x, y, z coordinate tensors into shuffled Z-order keys using pre-computed lookup tables
decode_z_order_key_to_xyz: decode shuffled Z-order keys back into x, y, z coordinate tensors and batch index
encode_xyz_with_batch_index: encode x, y, z coordinates with a batch index into shuffled Z-order keys for batched octree operations
create_key_lut_encode_tables: create or retrieve device-specific encoding lookup tables for fast Z-order key generation from coordinates
create_key_lut_decode_tables: create or retrieve device-specific decoding lookup tables for fast coordinate extraction from Z-order keys
